mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS plan_id, p.plan_no, p.order_id, p.order_detail_id, p.supplier_id, p.plan_quantity, p.plan_date, p.status, p.is_deleted, p.create_time, p.update_time, o.order_no, pm.EXTERNAL_PART_NO AS parts_no, pm.CHINESE_NAME AS parts_name, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.ship_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn a WHERE a.order_detail_id = p.order_detail_id AND IFNULL(a.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND a.status = 'SHIPPED'), 0) AS shipped_qty, CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.ship_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn a WHERE a.order_detail_id = p.order_detail_id AND IFNULL(a.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND a.status = 'SHIPPED'), 0) >= p.plan_quantity THEN 'SHIPPED' ELSE p.status END AS calculated_status FROM tb_delivery_plan p INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order o ON p.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d ON d.id = p.order_detail_id LEFT JOIN tb_parts_maint pm ON d.parts_number = pm.PARTS_NO AND pm.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE p.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY p.id ASC

SELECT p.id AS plan_id, p.plan_no, p.order_id, p.order_detail_id, p.supplier_id, p.plan_quantity, p.plan_date, p.status, p.is_deleted, p.create_time, p.update_time, o.order_no, pm.EXTERNAL_PART_NO AS parts_no, pm.CHINESE_NAME AS parts_name, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.ship_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn a WHERE a.order_detail_id = p.order_detail_id AND IFNULL(a.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND a.status = 'SHIPPED'), 0) AS shipped_qty, CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.ship_qty) FROM tb_srm_asn a WHERE a.order_detail_id = p.order_detail_id AND IFNULL(a.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND a.status = 'SHIPPED'), 0) >= p.plan_quantity THEN 'SHIPPED' ELSE p.status END AS calculated_status FROM tb_delivery_plan p INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order o ON p.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN tb_purchase_parts_order_detail d ON d.id = p.order_detail_id LEFT JOIN tb_parts_maint pm ON d.parts_number = pm.PARTS_NO AND pm.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE p.id = #{planId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_delivery_plan SET status = #{newStatus} WHERE id = #{planId}

UPDATE tb_delivery_plan SET actual_quantity = #{actualQuantity}, actual_eta_date = #{actualEtaDate}, tracking_no = #{trackingNo}, logistics_company = #{logisticsCompany}, ship_date = #{shipDate}, status = 'SHIPPED' WHERE id = #{planId}
UPDATE tb_delivery_plan SET asn_id = #{asnId} WHERE id = #{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(plan_quantity), 0) FROM tb_delivery_plan WHERE order_detail_id = #{orderDetailId} AND IFNULL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(plan_no, 4) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM tb_delivery_plan WHERE supplier_id = #{supplierId} AND plan_no LIKE CONCAT(#{planNoPrefix}, '%')
